divisors.meaning: div/rem nodes over the 48-function corpus split by divisor kind: literal (u32 constant operand) versus variable (param or node operand). Counted before and after optimize (which folds /1, %1 and strength-reduces literal powers of two to shr/and). Every remaining div/rem, either kind, is emitted as the shared 32-cycle a0_udiv unit.

stagesNotRun: ASIC synthesis with a real cell library
real clock-domain timing (simulation is zero-delay RTL)
